## Everything else

Hebrew outside the four bilingual pages, with no English twin: the company name,
the Hebrew month names, and the few places the STAFF app shows Hebrew. Lower
priority than the tables above — no customer reads most of it — but the month
names in particular are worth a glance, since every Hebrew date in the app is
built from them.
